instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Add things to my groups, lists or collections, move and reorder them, put some into a new group inside, take a group apart, or bring a whole folder tree in as groups", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:change-my-groups and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: A group is any list of addresses (records, pages, people, other groups) in an order; a member whose address is a group nests that group.

4. It reads and writes no store: your AI reads the group records (type group) from where it keeps them and hands them in as records, and puts the answer's keep (each changed record with the value it expected) in the store.
